title: Legendrian submanifolds in the unit sphere with conformal Maslov form and constant sectional curvature
summary: This paper is concerned with the study on Legendrian submanifolds with conformal Maslov form in the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{2n+1}$, which admits a Sasakian structure $(\varphi,ξ,η,g)$ for $n\ge2$. As the main result, we classify such submanifolds with constant sectional curvature, motivated by the classification result of the minimal Legendrian submanifolds with constant sectional curvature.
